intro.title: Finance → General Ledger
lines: Each revenue type has its own ledger rules: a default GL code,
when revenue is recognized, and the exact debit/credit entries.
The Purchase / Service Delivery tag shows the current recognition mode.
intro.narration: This is the General Ledger, under Finance. Every revenue type has its own set of ledger rules: a default GL code, a setting for when revenue is recognized, and the exact debit and credit entries that post. The Purchase or Service Delivery tag on each row shows its current recognition mode. Let's go through them.

steps.title: Registrations · Service Delivery
lines: Program enrollments. Recognized at time of service delivery —
revenue is deferred, then recognized as each session occurs.
Note the default GL code, the recognition toggle, and the journal entries.
steps.narration: Registrations are program enrollments. Here revenue is recognized at the time of service delivery, which means it's deferred and then recognized as each session actually occurs. On the page you'll see the default GL code, the revenue recognition toggle, and the journal entries that post at purchase, at service delivery, and on refund.

steps.title: Memberships · Service Delivery
lines: Ongoing facility/program access. Recognized at service delivery.
Non-expiring memberships defer revenue over a set period — here, 12 months.
steps.narration: Memberships cover ongoing facility and program access, and are also recognized at service delivery. For non-expiring memberships, revenue is deferred evenly over a set period — here it's set to twelve months.

steps.title: Passes · Service Delivery
lines: Punch passes for flexible facility use. Recognized at service delivery,
with a deferral period for non-expiring passes.
steps.narration: Passes are punch passes for flexible facility use. They're recognized at service delivery as well, with a deferral period for non-expiring passes.

steps.title: Facility Rentals · Purchase
lines: Reservable spaces for private events. Recognized at time of purchase.
steps.narration: Facility Rentals are reservable spaces for private events. These are recognized at the time of purchase.

steps.title: Events · Purchase
lines: Ticketed experiences. Recognized at purchase.
The credit splits ticket face value and the ticket-service-fee GL.
steps.narration: Events are ticketed experiences. Revenue is recognized at purchase, and the credit is split between the ticket face value and the ticket service fee GL code from your finance settings.

steps.title: Direct Credit Adds
lines: Manual, one-off account-credit top-ups applied by an admin.
Sets the entries for adding and removing credit.
steps.narration: Direct Credit Adds are manual, one-off account credit top-ups applied by an admin. This page sets the entries for both adding and removing credit.

steps.title: Products
lines: Store items, add-ons, and facility-rental extras.
steps.narration: Products covers store items, add-ons, and facility rental extras.

steps.title: Security Deposits
lines: Refundable deposits for rentals and equipment —
held as a liability and returned on refund.
steps.narration: Security Deposits are refundable deposits for rentals and equipment. They're held as a liability and returned when refunded.

steps.title: Transaction Fees
lines: Processing and administrative costs for payments.
steps.narration: Transaction Fees captures the processing and administrative costs associated with taking payments.

steps.title: Gift Cards
lines: The GL entries for gift-card activity.
steps.narration: Gift Cards defines the entries for gift card activity.

steps.title: Scholarships
lines: The journal entries that post when a scholarship is issued, used, and expires.
steps.narration: Scholarships sets the journal entries that post when a scholarship is issued, when it's used, and when it expires.

steps.title: Taxes
lines: Tax charges on eligible transactions.
steps.narration: And finally, Taxes covers tax charges on eligible transactions.
